risks.title: Cybersecurity and system disruption risks
risks.summary: Information system disruptions or breaches could harm the business. A formal crisis management plan is in place to respond to incidents, covering internal reporting, assessment, communication strategy, monitoring, and recovery.
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in the operational risks section. A structured crisis management plan is in place. Potential consequences include financial, regulatory, and reputational impacts, indicating high severity. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulatory and customs risks related to ethylene oxide
risks.summary: The EPA has regulated ethylene oxide (EtO) for medical device sterilization with phased compliance periods and required mitigation measures. Customers must install new emission abatement equipment, which could impact the availability of Balchem's EtO products.
risks.score_rationale: Detailed in the Business section. The EPA issued an interim decision strictly regulating EtO use in medical sterilization, with phase-out periods and multi-year phased compliance obligations. Significant operational and financial impact for customers and potentially for Balchem. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: EU anti-dumping duties on choline chloride
risks.summary: The European Commission imposed provisional anti-dumping duties (95.4%-120.8%) in July 2025, followed by definitive duties (90.0%-115.9%), on choline chloride imports originating from China. This decision could potentially affect Balchem's sales and product competitiveness in Europe.
risks.score_rationale: Detailed in Recent Developments. The EU imposed definitive duties between 90.0% and 115.9% on choline chloride imports in July 2025, with clear rules on origin. Significant and direct financial impact on affected operations and European customers. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Litigation and legal proceedings risks
risks.summary: The company is regularly involved in various legal proceedings, including commercial and contractual disputes, employment litigation, product claims, environmental matters, and intellectual property issues. The company believes these cases will not have a material impact on its financial position.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Legal Proceedings. Balchem is regularly involved in various commercial, contractual, employment, product, and environmental litigations. Although the company believes current cases will not have a material effect, the diversity of litigation justifies moderate severity. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Dependence on macroeconomic and competitive conditions
risks.summary: Future sales may fluctuate based on general macroeconomic conditions, competitive dynamics, changes in customer preferences, and the ability to successfully launch new products into the market.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in MD&A under Net Sales. Future performance may fluctuate based on general economic conditions, competitive dynamics, and customer preferences. This highlights sensitivity to external factors. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Manufacturing input cost risks
risks.summary: An increase in manufacturing input costs could affect the company's margins. Although higher costs in 2025 were partially offset by favorable product mix and higher selling prices, ongoing pressures could reduce profitability.
risks.score_rationale: Indicated in MD&A under Gross Margin. The increase in gross margin was partially offset by higher manufactured input costs. While currently managed, a significant escalation could affect profitability. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: Balchem Corporation does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 2025 annual report. The company focuses on the development, manufacturing, and distribution of specialty performance ingredients for nutritional, pharmaceutical, and industrial markets, with no explicit reference to AI or related technologies.
